pib.title: From Personal Gifts to a Public Cause: Andhra Pradeshs PM Mementos Support a National Mission
pib.summary: Release text as printed (first sentence): 'The 18 mementos from Andhra Pradesh featured in the PM Mementos collection showcase the state's cultural heritage, traditional crafts and public achievements'

pib.title: Indian Railways Approves New Tri-Weekly Train Between Machilipatnam and Kurnool City via Vijayawada of South Coast Railway
pib.summary: Release text as printed (first sentence): 'In a major relief to the commuters of Andhra Pradesh, the Indian Railways has approved a new tri-weekly train service between Machilipatnam and Kurnool City via Vijayawada of South Coast Railway, providing an additional rail connectivity option between coastal and central parts of Andhra Pradesh'

pib.title: Union Minister for Civil Aviation Shri. Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu Inaugurates OFAA’s Kurnool Base, Andhra Pradesh’s First Flying Training Organisation
pib.summary: Release text as printed (first sentence): 'Orient Flights Aviation Academy (OFAA), a DGCA-approved Flight Training Organisation (FTO) and a unit of Orient Flights Pvt'

pib.title: Indian Railways Approves ₹142 Crore for Upgradation of Electric Traction System to 2x25 kV on 73 RKM Savalyapuram-Guntur Section
pib.summary: Release text as printed (first sentence): 'Indian Railways has approved the upgradation of the electric traction system from 1x25 kV to 2x25 kV on the 73 Route Kilometre Savalyapuram-Guntur section of South Coast Railway at a total cost of ₹142 crore'

figures.label: Amount stated in the release title

pib.title: Union Health Minister Shri J P Nadda Inaugurates Critical Care Blocks and Integrated Public Health Laboratories in Andhra Pradesh
pib.summary: Release text as printed (first sentence): 'Union Minister for Health & Family Welfare, Shri Jagat Prakash Nadda today inaugurated 10 Critical Care Blocks (CCBs) and 12 Integrated Public Health Laboratories (IPHLs) in Andhra Pradesh in the presence of Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh Shri N. Chandrababu Naidu and Minister for Health, Family Welfare & Medical Education, Government of Andhra Pradesh Shri Satya Kumar Yadav, along with Members of Parliament, Members of the Legislative Assembly and Legislative Council, senior officers, doctors'
pib.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

pib.title: Nandyal District Strengthens Water Conservation Infrastructure and Storage Capacity under Catch the Rain Campaign
pib.summary: Release text as printed (first sentence): 'The Catch the Rain Campaign (4th July–4th August 2026) is being implemented across Nandyal District of Andhra Pradesh with the objective of conserving every drop of rainwater through the restoration of traditional water bodies, desilting of feeder channels, revival of tank systems, and creation of additional water storage'

pib.title: Centre Continues Support for Judicial Infrastructure Development in Andhra Pradesh Under Centrally Sponsored Scheme.
pib.summary: Release text as printed (first sentence): 'The primary responsibility for development of infrastructure facilities for District and Subordinate Courts rests with the State Governments/UTs'

pib.title: Accelerated Railway Projects in Andhra Pradesh: Budget Allocation Increased to Rs. 10,134 Crore for FY 2026-27
pib.summary: Release text as printed (first sentence): 'Union Minister for Railways and Information & Broadcasting Shri Ashwini Vaishnaw replied in Parliament to questions raised by Rajya Sabha Member Shri Bhashyam Rama Krishna regarding the progress of ongoing and pending railway projects, ROB/RUB constructions, and station redevelopment works in Andhra Pradesh'

pib.title: Centre Gives Top Priority to Railway Infrastructure Development in Andhra Pradesh: Rs. 10,134 Crore Allocated for 2026-27

Avinash Reddy and Shri P.V. Mithun Reddy regarding the progress and allocations for various railway projects being undertaken in Andhra Pradesh'

pib.title: PACS Services in Andhra Pradesh
pib.summary: Release text as printed (first sentence): 'The Ministry of Cooperation, in collaboration with CSC e-Governance Services India Limited (CSC SPV), is facilitating the functioning of eligible Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS) as Common Service Centres (CSCs) to enable them to provide a wide range of digital and citizen-centric services in rural areas including Andhra Pradesh'
